question.wording: What were the payments this Form 1099-K reports in box 1a?

options.label: Receipts of a business — Schedule C line 1
Rents from real property — Schedule E line 3
Personal items sold at a gain — Form 8949 / Schedule D (line 7a)
An activity not engaged in for profit — Schedule 1 line 8j
All of it in error (gifts, reimbursements) or personal items sold at a loss — not income

citation.wording: The remaining amounts reported to you on Form(s) 1099-K should be reported elsewhere on your return depending on the nature of the transactions.
